en.s: Pope Marcellinus (sometimes anglicized to Marceline or Marcelline) was the bishop of Rome from 30 June 296 to his death in 304. Some sources claim he may have renounced Christianity during Emperor Diocletian's persecution of Christians – which might explain why he is omitted from lists of martyrs. The claim is rejected by others, including Augustine of Hippo.

zh.t: 教宗马塞利努斯开始任职
zh.s: 教宗马塞利努斯（有时也译作马塞林或马塞琳）于296年6月30日至304年去世前担任罗马主教。有些资料称，他可能在戴克里先迫害基督徒期间放弃了基督教，这或许可以解释他为何没有列入一些殉道者名单。河马的奥古斯丁等人则否认这一说法。

en.s: The Conquest of Merida was a military engagement between the Umayyads and the Visigothic garrison. The Umayyads endured a hard siege that lasted several months before the Umayyads succeeded in capturing the city, achieving a notable victory.

en.s: The battle of Anchialus (Bulgarian: Битката при Анхиало) occurred in 763, near the town of Pomorie on the Bulgarian Black Sea Coast. The result was a Byzantine victory.

en.s: The Battle of Philippopolis or battle of Plovdiv (Bulgarian: Битка при Пловдив) took place on 30 June 1208 in the surroundings of Philippopolis (modern Plovdiv, Bulgaria) between the armies of the Bulgarian Empire and the Latin Empire. The Crusaders were victorious.

zh.s: 菲利波波利斯之战又称普罗夫迪夫之战（保加利亚语：Битка при Пловдив），于1208年6月30日在菲利波波利斯（今保加利亚普罗夫迪夫）附近爆发，交战双方是保加利亚帝国和拉丁帝国军队。十字军获胜。

en.t: Zhu Yunwen ascended the throne to the Ming dynasty to become the Jianwen Emperor
en.s: The Ming dynasty, officially the Great Ming, was an imperial dynasty of China that ruled from 1368 to 1644, following the collapse of the Mongol-led Yuan dynasty. The Ming was the last imperial dynasty of China ruled by the Han people, the majority ethnic group in China.

zh.s: 1398年6月30日，朱允炆继承明朝皇位，成为建文帝。

en.s: The Jianwen Emperor (5 December 1377 – 13 July 1402), personal name Zhu Yunwen, was the second emperor of the Ming dynasty of China, reigning from 1398 to 1402. Zhu Yunwen's father was Zhu Biao, the eldest son and heir apparent of the Hongwu Emperor, the founder of the Ming dynasty. Zhu Biao died in 1392, after which the Hongwu Emperor named Zhu Yunwen as his successor.

zh.s: 建文帝朱允炆（1377年12月5日—1402年7月13日）是中国明朝第二位皇帝，1398年至1402年在位。朱允炆的父亲朱标是明太祖朱元璋的长子和皇位继承人；朱标于1392年去世后，朱元璋指定朱允炆为继承人。

en.s: The Battle of Sanluri was fought on June 30, 1409 between the armies of the Giudicato of Arborea (a kingdom in Sardinia) and the Catalan-Sicilian army of King Martin I of Sicily. The location was the fortified village of Sanluri. The Arborean army was led by giudice William III of Narbonne, and Martin commanded in person the Aragonese army. The Sardinian army was composed mostly of mercenaries, including the renowned Genoese crossbowmen and other units from France and northern Italy. There are few details about the battle. The Aragonese were less numerous though better trained, and managed to divide the Arborean army in two parts which were then destroyed separately.

zh.s: 圣卢里之战于1409年6月30日爆发，交战双方是撒丁岛阿尔博雷亚王国的军队和西西里国王马丁一世率领的加泰罗尼亚—西西里联军。战场是设防村庄圣卢里。阿尔博雷亚军由纳博讷的威廉三世领军，马丁则亲自指挥阿拉贡军队。撒丁军主要由雇佣兵组成，包括著名的热那亚弩手，以及来自法国和意大利北部的其他部队。关于战斗的具体情况记载不多。阿拉贡军人数较少，但训练更好；他们将阿尔博雷亚军分割成两部分，分别击溃。

en.s: The Battle of Tábor took place in the early morning hours of 30 June 1420 in a locality between Tismenický stream and the Lužnice near the walls of a newly emerging Hussite village called Tábor. Between 3,000 and 9,000 Taborites, including women and children, remained in the village after a Hussite detachment left for Prague. Taking advantage of their weakened state, Oldřich II of Rosenberg laid siege to the village.

zh.s: 塔博尔之战于1420年6月30日清晨爆发，地点在新兴的胡斯派村庄塔博尔城墙附近、蒂斯梅尼采河与卢日尼采河之间。当时一支胡斯派分队已前往布拉格，村中留下3,000至9,000名塔博尔派成员，包括妇女和儿童。罗森堡的奥德日赫二世趁村中防备薄弱，开始围攻该村。

en.s: The Battle of Arbedo was fought on June 30, 1422 between the Duchy of Milan and the Swiss Confederation. In 1419, Uri and Unterwalden bought the Bellinzona stronghold from the Sacco barons, but were unable to defend it adequately. When, in 1422, they rejected the Milanese proposal to buy back the fortified town, their troops stationed in Bellinzona were put to rout by the Visconti army under the command of Francesco Bussone, called Il Carmagnola. An attempt to reconquer the fortified area with the support of other confederates led to the battle at Arbedo, a village 3 km north of Bellinzona.

zh.s: 阿尔贝多之战于1422年6月30日在米兰公国与瑞士邦联之间爆发。1419年，乌里和下瓦尔登从萨科男爵手中买下贝林佐纳要塞，但未能有效防守。1422年，两地拒绝米兰提出的买回该设防城镇的建议后，驻扎在贝林佐纳的部队被弗朗切斯科·布索内（绰号“卡尔马尼奥拉”）指挥的维斯孔蒂军队击溃。瑞士邦联其他成员随后支援收复设防地区，双方在阿尔贝多村交战；该村位于贝林佐纳以北3公里。

en.s: The Battle of Seckenheim (June 1462) saw the army of the Electoral Palatinate led by Frederick I, Elector Palatine and his ally Dieter von Isenburg face an invading army led by Charles I, Margrave of Baden-Baden, Ulrich V, Count of Württemberg, Louis I, Count Palatine of Zweibrücken, and George of Baden, the Bishop of Metz. Without warning, Frederick suddenly struck at the invaders, trapping them in the fork of two major rivers.

zh.s: 塞肯海姆战役于1462年6月爆发。普法尔茨选帝侯腓特烈一世及其盟友迪特尔·冯·伊森堡率军，对阵巴登-巴登藩侯卡尔一世、符腾堡伯爵乌尔里希五世、茨魏布吕肯伯爵路德维希一世以及梅斯主教巴登的格奥尔格率领的入侵军。腓特烈突然发动进攻，将敌军困在两条大河交汇处。

en.s: The Battle of Noáin or the Battle of Esquiroz, fought on June 30, 1521 was the only open field battle in the Spanish conquest of Iberian Navarre. It was a decisive victory for the Spanish against the Franco-Navarrese army.

zh.s: 诺艾因之战又称埃斯基罗兹之战，于1521年6月30日爆发，是西班牙征服伊比利亚纳瓦拉期间唯一一场野战。西班牙军队击败法兰西—纳瓦拉联军，取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Colhuacatonco was fought on 30 June 1521 during the late stages of the Siege of Tenochtitlan between Spanish-Tlaxcalan forces and the Mexica Empire (also typically referred as Aztec Empire). It is regarded as the most important victory achieved by the Mexica during the siege.

zh.s: 科尔瓦卡通科之战于1521年6月30日爆发，是特诺奇蒂特兰围城战后期的一场战斗，交战双方是西班牙—特拉斯卡拉联军和墨西加帝国（通常也称阿兹特克帝国）。这被视为墨西加人在围城期间取得的最重要胜利。

en.t: Henry II of France is wounded in a joust
en.s: On June 30, 1559, King Henry II of France suffered a serious eye injury during a joust in Paris when Gabriel de Montgomery’s lance splintered. He died from his injuries ten days later, on July 10.

zh.t: 法国国王亨利二世在比武中受重伤
zh.s: 1559年6月30日，法国国王亨利二世在巴黎参加马上长枪比武时，加布里埃尔·德·蒙哥马利的长枪折断，碎片刺伤了他的眼睛。亨利二世于十天后的7月10日因伤去世。

en.s: The free election of 1587 was the third royal election to be held in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which took place after the death of King Stefan Batory. It began on June 30, 1587, when Election Sejm was summoned in the village of Wola near Warsaw, and ended on December 27 of the same year, when King Sigismund III was crowned in Kraków’s Wawel Cathedral.

zh.s: 1587年自由选王是波兰—立陶宛联邦举行的第三次王室选举，斯特凡·巴托里国王去世后启动。选举议会于1587年6月30日在华沙附近的沃拉村召开，选举由此开始；同年12月27日，西吉斯蒙德三世在克拉科夫瓦维尔主教座堂加冕，选举过程结束。

en.s: The Battle of Reval took place on June 30, 1602, during the Polish–Swedish War (1600–1611) near present-day Tallinn in Estonia. The Polish forces were led by Grand Field Hetman Stanisław Żółkiewski who had been sent against Swedish forces gathering by Tallinn by Grand Crown Hetman Jan Zamoyski. Żółkiewski attacked "on the march" with two squadrons of Polish hussars. The charge however was not successful. As a result, the Swedish forces put up frisian horses as a protection against further frontal cavalry charges. Żółkiewski then sent light cavalry on a round about flanking maneuver which attacked the Swedes from behind, coinciding with another charge by the hussars.

zh.s: 雷瓦尔之战于1602年6月30日在波瑞战争（1600—1611年）期间爆发，战场靠近今爱沙尼亚首都塔林。波军由大盖特曼扬·扎莫厄斯基派出的斯坦尼斯瓦夫·若乌凯夫斯基指挥，任务是进攻集结在塔林附近的瑞军。若乌凯夫斯基率领两支波兰翼骑兵中队在行进中发动冲锋，但未能奏效。瑞军随后设置拒马障碍，抵御正面骑兵冲锋。若乌凯夫斯基于是派轻骑兵绕道侧翼，从后方攻击瑞军，同时翼骑兵再次发起冲锋。

en.s: The Battle of Marabda (Georgian: მარაბდის ბრძოლა) (Persian: نبرد مارابدا) took place on 30 June 1625, or July 1, 1625, when the Iranian Safavid army defeated a Georgian force. This battle occurred after the Battle of Martqopi in the same year, when the Iranian army was routed.

zh.s: 马拉布达战役（格鲁吉亚语：მარაბდის ბრძოლა；波斯语：نبرد مارابدا）发生于1625年6月30日（也有资料记为1625年7月1日）。伊朗萨法维军队击败了格鲁吉亚军队。此前同年，萨法维军队在马尔特科皮战役中被击溃。

en.t: The University of Tartu is founded
en.s: The University of Tartu (Estonian: Tartu Ülikool) is a public research university in Tartu, Estonia. It is the national university of Estonia, as well as the largest and oldest university in the country. The university was founded in 1632 by Gustavus Adolphus, at the time the king of Sweden. Currently, 15,573 students study at the university, of whom 1,435 are foreigners (9%).

zh.s: 塔尔图大学（爱沙尼亚语：Tartu Ülikool）是位于爱沙尼亚塔尔图的一所公立研究型大学。它是爱沙尼亚的国立大学，也是该国规模最大、历史最悠久的大学。该校由瑞典国王古斯塔夫·阿道夫于1632年创立。目前有15573名学生，其中1435人（9%）为外国学生。

en.s: The Battle of Adwalton Moor occurred on 30 June 1643 at Adwalton, West Yorkshire, during the First English Civil War. In the battle, the Royalists loyal to King Charles led by the Earl of Newcastle soundly defeated the Parliamentarians commanded by Lord Fairfax.

zh.s: 阿德沃尔顿荒原之战于1643年6月30日在西约克郡阿德沃尔顿爆发，是第一次英国内战的一场战斗。纽卡斯尔伯爵率领查理国王的保王派军队，大败费尔法克斯勋爵指挥的议会军。

en.s: The Khmelnytsky Uprising, also known as the Cossack–Polish War, Khmelnytsky insurrection, Cossack Revolution, or, in Ukraine, as the National Liberation War, was a successful Cossack rebellion with elements of a religious war that took place between 1648 and 1657 in the eastern territories of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. Originating in Dnieper Ukraine, the uprising resulted in a Cossack victory and led to the creation of the Cossack Hetmanate.
en.n: The Deluge: Khmelnytsky Uprising: The Battle of Berestechko ends with a Polish victory.

zh.s: 赫梅利尼茨基起义又称哥萨克—波兰战争、赫梅利尼茨基叛乱、哥萨克革命；在乌克兰也称民族解放战争。这是一场成功的哥萨克起义，带有宗教战争的特点，发生于1648至1657年波兰—立陶宛联邦东部地区。起义源自第聂伯河乌克兰，最终哥萨克获胜，并建立哥萨克酋长国。
zh.n: 大洪水时期：赫梅利尼茨基起义：别列斯捷奇科战役以波兰获胜告终。

en.s: The siege of Namur, 25 May–30 June 1692, was a major engagement of the Nine Years' War, and was part of the French grand plan (devised over the winter of 1691–92) to defeat the forces of the Grand Alliance and bring a swift conclusion to the war. Namur, sitting on the confluence of the Meuse and Sambre rivers, was a considerable fortress, and was a significant political and military asset.

zh.s: 九年战争期间，1692年5月25日至6月30日的那慕尔围城战是一场重要战役，也是法国于1691—92年冬季制定的宏大战略的一部分，旨在击败大同盟军并迅速结束战争。那慕尔位于默兹河与桑布尔河交汇处，是一座重要的要塞，具有显著的政治和军事价值。

en.s: The Battle of Ekeren, June 30, 1703 was a battle of the War of the Spanish Succession. The French surrounded a Dutch force, which barely avoided destruction. This battle ended hope of a decisive allied victory in the Spanish Netherlands in 1703.

zh.s: 埃克伦之战于1703年6月30日爆发，是西班牙王位继承战争的一场战斗。法军包围了一支荷兰军队，荷军勉强避免全军覆没。此战使盟军失去了在1703年于西属尼德兰取得决定性胜利的希望。

en.s: The siege of Danzig of 1734 was the Russian encirclement (22 February – 30 June) and capture of the Polish city-port of Gdańsk, during the War of Polish Succession. It was the first time that troops of France and Russia had met as foes in the field.

en.s: The Tillali Massacre (Danish: Massakren i Tillali), or the Battle of Tillali (Danish: Slaget ved Tillali) was a confrontation on 30 June 1756 during the Cattle War, between the Danish command at the village of Tillali (Thillaiyadi) and the Raja of Thanjavur, Pratap Singh. The confrontation resulted in a Thanjavurian victory and a subsequent massacre of most Danish troops.

zh.s: 蒂拉利大屠杀又称蒂拉利之战（丹麦语：Massakren i Tillali；Slaget ved Tillali），是1756年6月30日牛战期间的一场冲突。交战双方是驻扎在蒂拉利村（今蒂莱亚迪）的丹麦部队和坦贾武尔王公普拉塔普·辛格的军队。坦贾武尔获胜，随后大多数丹麦士兵遭到屠杀。

en.s: The Battle of Domstadtl, also spelled Domstadt, Czech Domašov, was a battle between Habsburg Monarchy and Kingdom of Prussia at a Moravian village Domašov nad Bystřicí during the Seven Years' War on 30 June 1758, preceded by a minor clash at Guntramovice (Gundersdorf) on 28 June. Austrians under the command of Major General Ernst Gideon von Laudon and Major General Joseph von Siskovits attacked and destroyed a supply convoy bound for the Prussian army besieging Olomouc (Olmütz). The Austrian victory saved the city and the Prussian King Frederick the Great was forced to leave Moravia.

zh.s: 多姆施塔特尔之战又称多姆施塔特之战（捷克语：Domašov），是七年战争期间哈布斯堡君主国与普鲁士王国在摩拉维亚多马绍夫村交战的一场战斗，发生于1758年6月30日。此前，双方于6月28日在贡特拉莫维采（贡德斯多夫）发生小规模冲突。恩斯特·吉迪恩·冯·劳东和约瑟夫·冯·西斯科维茨少将率领奥军袭击并摧毁了一支正前往支援围攻奥洛穆茨的普军的补给车队。奥军获胜保住了该城，普鲁士国王腓特烈大帝被迫撤出摩拉维亚。

en.s: The Battle of Alligator Bridge took place on June 30, 1778, and was the only major engagement in an unsuccessful campaign to conquer British East Florida during the American Revolutionary War. A detachment of Georgia militiamen under the command of General James Screven chased Thomas Brown's Loyalist company into a large position of British regulars established by British Major Mark Prevost and were turned back.

zh.s: 鳄鱼桥之战于1778年6月30日爆发，是美国独立战争期间一场未能征服英属东佛罗里达的战役中唯一的大规模交战。詹姆斯·斯克里文将军率领一支佐治亚民兵分队追击托马斯·布朗的保皇派部队，后者退入英国少校马克·普雷沃斯特布置的大批正规军阵地；民兵最终被击退。

en.s: The Raid on Chester occurred during the American Revolution when the US privateer, Captain Noah Stoddard of Fairhaven, Massachusetts, and four other privateer vessels attacked the British settlement at Chester, Nova Scotia on 30 June 1782. The town was defended by Captain Jonathan Prescott.

zh.t: 突袭新斯科舍省切斯特
zh.s: 美国独立战争期间，1782年6月30日，来自马萨诸塞州费尔黑文的私掠船船长诺亚·斯托达德与另外四艘私掠船一起，袭击了英国在新斯科舍省切斯特的聚居点。当地由乔纳森·普雷斯科特上尉负责防守。

en.s: The Siege of Fort Recovery, June 30, 1794, was a battle of the Northwest Indian War, fought at the present-day village of Fort Recovery, Ohio. As an American victory, it spelled the beginning of the end of the Confederation of Ohio Algonquians, under the control of the powerful Three Fires Confederation.

zh.s: 复兴堡围城战于1794年6月30日在今美国俄亥俄州复兴堡村发生，是西北印第安战争的一场战斗。美国获胜，这标志着由强大的三火联盟控制的俄亥俄阿尔冈昆人联盟开始走向瓦解。

en.s: The action of 30 June 1798 was a minor naval engagement fought along the Biscay coast of France during the French Revolutionary Wars. The French Navy had been largely driven from the Atlantic Ocean early in the war following heavy losses in a series of failed operations. This had allowed the Royal Navy's Channel Fleet to institute a close blockade on the French naval ports of the Biscay coast, particularly Brest in Brittany.

zh.s: 1798年6月30日，法国革命战争期间，法国比斯开湾沿岸发生了一场小规模海战。战争初期，法国海军在一系列行动失利、损失惨重后，基本被逐出大西洋。这使英国皇家海军海峡舰队得以对法国比斯开湾沿岸的海军港口实施严密封锁，尤其是布列塔尼的布雷斯特港。

en.s: The Battle of Ballyellis on 30 June 1798 was a clash during the Irish Rebellion of 1798 (Éirí Amach 1798 in Irish), between a surviving column of the dispersed Wexford rebel army and pursuing British forces which resulted in a victory for the rebels.

zh.s: 巴利埃利斯之战于1798年6月30日爆发，是1798年爱尔兰起义期间的一场战斗。威克斯福德叛军主力被击散后，一支残余部队与追击的英军交战，最终叛军获胜。

en.s: The Third Battle of Tuxpan was one of the three small battles of the Mexican-American War to occur in Tuxpan, Mexico. The engagement occurred on June 30, 1847, between Mexican troops and or militia and an American landing force from the Mosquito Fleet under Matthew C. Perry.Not much is known but a skirmish was fought, ending in the deaths of one U.S. man, and another who died two or three days later. Five other men were wounded, not including the said sixth man who died later on. At least four of the wounded Americans were made casualties by a gunpowder barrel explosion, caused by an unknown source.

zh.s: 图斯潘第三次战斗是美墨战争期间在墨西哥图斯潘发生的三场小规模战斗之一。1847年6月30日，墨西哥军队或民兵与马修·C·佩里率领的“蚊子舰队”美国登陆部队交战。已知情况不多，但双方发生过小规模冲突，一名美国人当场死亡，另一人两三天后伤重不治。另有五名美国人受伤，不包括后来死亡的第六人。至少四名伤员是被一只火药桶爆炸波及，爆炸原因不明。

en.s: The Battle of Chinhat was fought on the morning of 30 June 1857, between British forces and Indian rebels, at Ismailganj, near Chinhat (or Chinhut), Oude (Awad/Oudh). The British were led by The Chief Commissioner of Oude, Sir Henry Lawrence. The insurgent force, which consisted of mutineers from the East India Company's army and retainers of local landowners, was led by Barkat Ahmad, a mutineer officer of the Company's army.

zh.s: 1857年6月30日清晨，英国军队与印度起义军在奥德地区伊斯梅尔甘吉村、钦哈特（又称钦胡特）附近交战。英军由奥德首席专员亨利·劳伦斯爵士率领。起义军由巴尔卡特·艾哈迈德指挥，成员包括东印度公司军队中的哗变士兵和当地地主的侍从。

en.s: The Battle of Glendale, also known as the Battle of Frayser's Farm, Frazier's Farm, Nelson's Farm, Charles City Crossroads, New Market Road, or Riddell's Shop, took place on June 30, 1862, in Henrico County, Virginia, on the sixth day of the Seven Days Battles (Peninsula Campaign) of the American Civil War. The Confederate divisions of Maj. Gens. Benjamin Huger, James Longstreet, and A.P. Hill converged on the retreating Union Army in the vicinity of Glendale or Frayser's Farm. Longstreet's and Hill's attacks penetrated the Union defense near Willis Church. Union counterattacks sealed the break and saved their line of retreat along the Willis Church Road.

zh.s: 格伦代尔之战又称弗雷泽农场之战、弗雷泽农场战役、纳尔逊农场之战、查尔斯城十字路口之战、新市场路之战或里德尔商店之战，于1862年6月30日在弗吉尼亚州亨里科县爆发，是美国内战半岛战役“七日战役”的第六天。南军本杰明·休格、詹姆斯·朗斯特里特和A·P·希尔少将率部在格伦代尔或弗雷泽农场附近合围撤退中的联邦军。朗斯特里特和希尔的进攻突破了威利斯教堂附近的联邦防线。联邦军发动反击，封住缺口，保住沿威利斯教堂路撤退的通道。

en.s: The Battle of White Oak Swamp took place on June 30, 1862 in Henrico County, Virginia as part of the Seven Days Battles (Peninsula Campaign) of the American Civil War. As the Union Army of the Potomac retreated southeast toward the James River, its rearguard under Maj. Gen. William B. Franklin stopped Maj. Gen. Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson's divisions at the White Oak Bridge crossing, resulting in an artillery duel, while the main Battle of Glendale raged two miles (3 km) farther south around Frayser's Farm. White Oak Swamp is generally considered to be part of the larger Glendale engagement.

zh.s: 白橡树沼泽之战于1862年6月30日在弗吉尼亚州亨里科县爆发，是美国内战半岛战役“七日战役”的一部分。波托马克联邦军向东南撤往詹姆斯河时，威廉·B·富兰克林少将率领的后卫部队在白橡桥渡口挡住了托马斯·J·“石墙”杰克逊少将的部队，双方展开炮战。与此同时，主要的格伦代尔之战正在以南约3公里的弗雷泽农场一带进行。白橡树沼泽之战通常被视为规模更大的格伦代尔战役的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Tampa, also known as the "Yankee Outrage at Tampa", was a minor engagement of the American Civil War fought June 30 – July 1, 1862, between the United States Navy and a Confederate artillery company charged with "protecting" the village of Tampa, Florida. Although small, Tampa's port was a key hub of trade for Central Florida, and several blockade runners from Tampa regularly slipped past the Union naval blockade that extended down the Atlantic coast around to Florida's west coast.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 坦帕之战又称“扬基人在坦帕的暴行”，是美国内战期间的一场小规模冲突，于1862年6月30日至7月1日发生在美国海军与一支南军炮兵部队之间。南军负责“保护”佛罗里达州坦帕村。坦帕虽小，却是佛罗里达中部重要的贸易枢纽；多艘从坦帕出发的破封锁船经常躲过沿大西洋海岸、延伸至佛罗里达西岸的联邦海军封锁。

en.s: The Battle of Hanover took place on June 30, 1863, in Hanover in southwestern York County, Pennsylvania, as part of the Gettysburg Campaign of the American Civil War. Maj. Gen. J.E.B. Stuart's Confederate cavalry, which was riding north to get around the Union Army of the Potomac, attacked a Federal cavalry regiment, driving it through the streets of Hanover. Brig. Gen. Elon Farnsworth's brigade arrived and counterattacked, routing the Confederate vanguard and nearly capturing Stuart himself. Stuart soon counterattacked. Reinforced by Brig. Gen. George A. Custer's Michigan Brigade, Farnsworth held his ground, and a stalemate ensued.

zh.s: 汉诺威之战于1863年6月30日在宾夕法尼亚州约克县西南部的汉诺威爆发，是美国内战葛底斯堡战役行动的一部分。J·E·B·斯图尔特少将率领南军骑兵向北迂回波托马克联邦军，途中袭击一支联邦骑兵团，将其赶过汉诺威街道。埃隆·法恩斯沃思准将率部赶到后发动反击，击溃南军前锋，斯图尔特本人也险些被俘。斯图尔特很快再次反击。乔治·A·卡斯特准将的密歇根旅增援后，法恩斯沃思守住阵地，双方陷入僵持。

en.s: The Skirmish of Sporting Hill was a relatively small skirmish during the Gettysburg Campaign of the American Civil War, taking place on June 30, 1863, at various locations in present-day Camp Hill, East Pennsboro Township and Hampden Township in Cumberland County, Pennsylvania. It is known as the northernmost engagement of Robert E. Lee's Army of Northern Virginia during the Civil War.

zh.s: 斯波廷山小冲突是美国内战葛底斯堡战役行动中的一场小规模交战，于1863年6月30日在今宾夕法尼亚州坎伯兰县的坎普希尔、东彭斯伯勒镇和汉普登镇等地爆发。这是罗伯特·E·李的北弗吉尼亚军团在内战期间最北端的一次交战。

en.t: Fighting near Goodrich’s Landing continues toward Lake Providence
en.s: On June 30, 1863, Confederate troops under William H. Parsons fought Union troops near Lake Providence, Louisiana. They withdrew when Union transports and gunboats approached, ending this phase of the fighting near Goodrich’s Landing.
en.n: This records the second day of the June 29–30 fighting.

zh.t: 古德里奇登陆点附近的战斗延续至普罗维登斯湖一带
zh.s: 1863年6月30日，威廉·H·帕森斯指挥的南军在美国路易斯安那州普罗维登斯湖附近与北军交战。北军运输船和炮艇接近后，南军撤退，古德里奇登陆点附近这一阶段的战斗结束。
zh.n: 此条记录为6月29日至30日战斗的第二天。

en.s: The Skirmish of Littlestown was a Pennsylvania military engagement before the Battle of Gettysburg in which "a few companies of skirmishers" of Union infantry defeated a Confederate detachment of J.E.B. Stuart's Cavalry Division.

zh.t: 利特尔斯敦小规模战斗

en.s: The First Serbian–Ottoman War (Serbian: Први српско-турски рат, romanized: Prvi srpsko-turski rat), was a military conflict fought by the Principality of Serbia against the Ottoman Empire. Serbia declared war on the Ottoman Empire on 30 June 1876, during the Herzegovina Uprising. A Serbian south- and westward offensive was repulsed by Ottoman troops after just three weeks of fighting, upon which Turkey then invaded Serbia proper.

zh.t: 第一次塞尔维亚—奥斯曼战争
zh.s: 第一次塞尔维亚—奥斯曼战争是塞尔维亚公国与奥斯曼帝国之间的一场军事冲突。1876年6月30日，黑塞哥维那起义期间，塞尔维亚向奥斯曼帝国宣战。塞尔维亚军队向南和向西推进，但在仅三周交战后被奥斯曼军队击退，随后土耳其军队入侵塞尔维亚本土。

en.s: The Serbian–Ottoman Wars (Serbian: Српско-османски ратови, romanized: Srpsko-osmanski ratovi), also known as the Serbian–Turkish Wars or Serbian Wars for Independence (Српски ратови за независност, Srpski ratovi za nezavisnost), were two consequent wars (1876–1877 and 1877–1878), fought between the Principality of Serbia and the Ottoman Empire. In conjunction with the Principality of Montenegro, Serbia declared war on the Ottoman Empire on 30 June 1876.

zh.t: 塞尔维亚—奥斯曼战争（1876—1878年）
zh.s: 塞尔维亚—奥斯曼战争又称塞尔维亚—土耳其战争或塞尔维亚独立战争，是塞尔维亚公国与奥斯曼帝国之间的两场连续战争，分别发生于1876—1877年和1877—1878年。塞尔维亚于1876年6月30日与黑山公国共同向奥斯曼帝国宣战。

en.t: Charles Guiteau is executed for assassinating James Garfield
en.s: On June 30, 1882, Charles J. Guiteau was hanged in Washington, D.C., for the murder of U.S. President James A. Garfield. Guiteau had shot Garfield on July 2, 1881; the president died on September 19.

zh.t: 刺杀加菲尔德总统的吉托被处决
zh.s: 1882年6月30日，查尔斯·吉托因谋杀美国总统詹姆斯·加菲尔德，在华盛顿被处以绞刑。吉托于1881年7月2日开枪射伤加菲尔德，总统于同年9月19日去世。

en.s: The 1888 North-West Territories general election elected members of the 2nd Legislative Council of the North-West Territories. The 2nd Legislative Council of the North-West Territories replaced the 1st Council of the North-West Territories. The 2nd Legislative Council of the North-West Territories was replaced by the 1st North-West Assembly in 1891 when the quota of elected members was reached. (A different 2nd Council of the Northwest Territories (1905–1951) was created in 1905, when the NWT lost most of its population, to differentiate the new one from the two legislative councils of the NWT that had existed 1876 to 1891.) The 1888 election was the first general election in the history of the North-West Territories, Canada. Elections were held in various districts between 20 June and 30 June 1888.

zh.s: 1888年西北地区大选选出了西北地区第二届立法委员会成员，取代第一届立法委员会。1891年，当选议员配额达到后，第二届立法委员会又被西北地区第一届议会取代。（1905年至1951年的另一届西北地区第二议会，是在西北地区人口大幅减少后于1905年成立的；当时需要将其与1876至1891年间的两个立法委员会区分开来。）这是加拿大西北地区历史上的首次大选，各选区于1888年6月20日至30日间分批投票。

en.s: The Homestead Strike, also known as the Homestead Steel Strike or Homestead Massacre, was an industrial lockout and strike which began on June 30, 1892, culminating in a battle between strikers and private security agents on July 6, 1892. The battle was one of the most serious disputes in U.S. labor history, third behind the Ludlow Massacre and the Battle of Blair Mountain. The dispute occurred at the Homestead Steel Works in the Pittsburgh area town of Homestead, Pennsylvania, between the Amalgamated Association of Iron and Steel Workers (the AA) and the Carnegie Steel Company.
en.n: This entry records the lockout in effect by 30 June 1892; the formal strike began on 1 July.

zh.s: 霍姆斯特德罢工又称霍姆斯特德钢铁罢工或霍姆斯特德惨案，是一场劳资封锁和罢工。到1892年6月30日，资方的停工封锁已在实行；7月6日，罢工者与私人保安爆发冲突。该冲突是美国劳工史上最严重的劳资纠纷之一，严重程度仅次于卢德洛惨案和布莱尔山之战。纠纷发生在宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡附近的霍姆斯特德钢铁厂，劳资双方是美国钢铁工人联合会与卡内基钢铁公司。
zh.n: 本条记录的是截至1892年6月30日已生效的封锁日期；正式罢工于7月1日开始。

en.t: The Prince of Wales officially opens London’s Tower Bridge
en.s: On June 30, 1894, Edward, Prince of Wales, officially opened Tower Bridge in London. The bridge spans the River Thames near the Tower of London.

zh.t: 伦敦塔桥举行正式开幕仪式
zh.s: 1894年6月30日，威尔士亲王爱德华为伦敦塔桥主持正式开幕仪式。塔桥横跨泰晤士河，位于伦敦塔附近。

en.s: The First Battle of Manzanillo was a series of naval engagements during the Spanish–American War on 30 June 1898 in and outside of the harbor of Manzanillo, Cuba. Three American gunboats were forced to retire after attacking a squadron of Spanish gunboats and auxiliaries.

zh.s: 曼萨尼约第一次海战是美西战争期间的一系列海战，于1898年6月30日在古巴曼萨尼约港内外发生。三艘美国炮艇袭击一支由西班牙炮艇和辅助船只组成的舰队后，被迫撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Tayacoba, June 30, 1898, (also spelled Tayabacao) was an American special operations effort to land supplies and reinforcements to Cuban rebels fighting for their independence in the Spanish–American War.

zh.s: 1898年6月30日，美西战争期间，美军实施一次特种作战行动，试图登陆并向争取独立的古巴起义军运送补给和援兵。这就是塔亚科巴之战，地名也写作塔亚巴考。

zh.t: 《物理学年鉴》收到爱因斯坦的狭义相对论论文

en.s: The Federal Meat Inspection Act of 1906 (FMIA) is a U.S. law that makes it illegal to adulterate or misbrand meat and meat products being sold as food, and ensures that meat and meat products are slaughtered and processed under strictly regulated sanitary conditions. These requirements also apply to imported meat products, which must be inspected under equivalent foreign standards.

zh.s: 《1906年联邦肉类检验法》（FMIA）是美国法律，禁止掺假或错误标注作为食品出售的肉类及肉制品，并要求屠宰和加工过程严格遵守卫生规定。进口肉类也适用这些要求，必须接受符合等效标准的检验。

en.s: The Tunguska event was the explosion of between 3 and 50 megatons TNT equivalent in the Russian Empire's Yeniseysk Governorate, near the Podkamennaya Tunguska River in modern Krasnoyarsk Krai, on the morning of 30 June [O.S. 17 June] 1908. It was the largest impact event on Earth in recorded history (though much larger impacts occurred in prehistoric times, including the Chicxulub impact which ended the Cretaceous period).

zh.s: 1908年6月30日早晨（儒略历6月17日），俄罗斯帝国叶尼塞斯克省、今克拉斯诺亚尔斯克边疆区石泉通古斯河附近发生爆炸，相当于3至50兆吨TNT当量。这是有记录以来地球上规模最大的撞击事件；史前也曾发生规模大得多的撞击，包括导致白垩纪结束的希克苏鲁伯撞击事件。

en.s: The Attack on the Boar's Head (30 June 1916) was an operation at Richebourg-l'Avoué in France, during the First World War. Troops of the 39th Division, XI Corps in the First Army of the British Expeditionary Force (BEF), advanced to capture the Boar's Head, a salient held by the German 6th Army. Two battalions of the 116th Brigade, with one battalion forming carrying parties, attacked the German front position before dawn on 30 June.

zh.s: 野猪头阵地袭击战发生于1916年6月30日，地点在法国里什堡-拉武埃，是第一次世界大战期间的一次军事行动。英国远征军第一集团军第十一军第三十九师向德国第六集团军控制的野猪头突出部推进，试图将其攻占。第116旅派出两个营在天亮前袭击德军前沿阵地，另一个营负责运送物资。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Darwin on 30 June 1917. This was triggered by the death of Nationalist MP Charles Howroyd. The by-election was won by Nationalist candidate William Spence, who had been defeated in his own seat of Darling at the 1917 election.

en.t: 1926 United States Senate special election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate special election in North Dakota took place on June 30, 1926. On June 22, 1925, Republican Senator Edwin F. Ladd died in office. Governor Arthur G. Sorlie appointed Gerald Nye, a former congressional candidate and a prominent progressive activist, to fill Ladd's vacancy. A special election and regularly scheduled election were scheduled for the same year, though the special election, to fill the remaining months of Ladd's term, took place months before the regularly scheduled election.

en.t: Release of Gone with the Wind (novel)
en.s: Gone with the Wind is a novel by American writer Margaret Mitchell, first published in 1936. The story is set in Clayton County and Atlanta, both in Georgia, during the American Civil War and Reconstruction era. It depicts the struggles of young Scarlett O'Hara, the spoiled oldest daughter of a well-to-do plantation owner, who must use every means at her disposal to claw her way out of poverty following Sherman's destructive "March to the Sea".

en.s: The Battle of Brody (other names in use include Battle of Dubna, Battle of Dubno, Battle of Rovne, Battle of Rovne-Brody) was a tank battle fought between the 1st Panzer Group's III Army Corps and XLVIII Army Corps (Motorized) and five mechanized corps of the Soviet 5th Army and 6th Army in the triangle formed by the towns Dubno, Lutsk, and Brody between 23 and 30 June 1941. It is known in Soviet historiography as a part of the "border defensive battles". Although the Red Army formations inflicted heavy losses on the German forces, they were outmanoeuvred and suffered enormous losses in tanks.

zh.s: 布罗迪之战又称杜布诺、罗夫诺或罗夫诺—布罗迪之战，是一场坦克战，于1941年6月23日至30日在杜布诺、卢茨克和布罗迪三座城镇围成的区域内爆发。交战双方是德军第一装甲集群的第三军、第四十八摩托化军，以及苏联第五和第六集团军的五个机械化军。苏联史学将此战列为“边境防御战”的一部分。红军部队虽给德军造成重大损失，却在机动作战中落入下风，坦克也损失惨重。

The operation was directed by the Supreme Allied Commander in the South West Pacific Area (SWPA), General Douglas MacArthur, whose forces had advanced along the northeast coast of New Guinea and occupied nearby islands.

en.s: Operation Epsom, also known as the First Battle of the Odon, was a British Second World War offensive that took place between 26 and 30 June 1944, during the Battle of Normandy. The offensive was intended to outflank and seize the German-occupied city of Caen, an important Allied objective, in the early stages of the Allied invasion of north-west Europe. Preceded by Operation Martlet to secure the right flank of the advance, Operation Epsom began early on 26 June, with units of the 15th (Scottish) Infantry Division advancing behind a rolling artillery barrage.

zh.s: 埃普索姆行动又称奥东河第一次战役，是英国在第二次世界大战诺曼底战役期间发动的一次进攻，时间为1944年6月26日至30日。行动计划从侧翼包围并攻占德军占领的重要城市卡昂，是盟军入侵西北欧初期的重要目标。此前，盟军实施了马特莱特行动以确保推进部队右翼安全。6月26日清晨，第15（苏格兰）步兵师在连续移动的炮火掩护下向前推进，行动由此开始。

en.s: The Battle of Cherbourg was part of the Battle of Normandy during World War II. It was fought immediately after the successful Allied landings on 6 June 1944. Allied troops, mainly American, isolated and captured the fortified port, which was considered vital to the campaign in Western Europe, in a hard-fought, month-long campaign.
en.n: World War II: The Battle of Cherbourg ends with the fall of the strategically valuable port to American forces.

en.s: The June 1946 Bavarian state election was held on 30 June 1946 to elect the members of the Bavarian Constituent Assembly. It was the first election held in Bavaria since 1932. en.t: Two airliners collide over the Grand Canyon
en.s: On June 30, 1956, TWA Flight 2, a Lockheed Super Constellation, collided with United Air Lines Flight 718, a Douglas DC-7, over the Grand Canyon in Arizona. All 128 people aboard the two aircraft died.

en.s: Pope Paul VI (born Giovanni Battista Enrico Antonio Maria Montini; 26 September 1897 – 6 August 1978) was head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of Vatican City from 21 June 1963 until his death on 6 August 1978. en.t: The National Organization for Women, the United States' largest feminist organization, is founded
en.s: The National Organization for Women (NOW) is an American progressive-left feminist organization. Founded in 1966, it is legally a 501(c)(4) social welfare organization. The organization consists of 550 chapters in all 50 U.S. states and in Washington, D.C. It is the largest feminist organization in the United States with around 500,000 members. en.s: French legislative elections took place on 23 and 30 June 1968 to elect the fourth French National Assembly of the Fifth Republic. They were held in the aftermath of the events of May 1968. While the workers went back to their jobs, Prime Minister Georges Pompidou campaigned for the "defence of the Republic" in the face of the "communist threat" and called for the "silent majority" to make themselves heard.

en.t: K-1 World MAX 2006 World Championship final
en.s: K-1 World MAX 2006 World Championship Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. It was the fifth K-1 World MAX final for middleweight kickboxers (70 kg/154 lb weight class), involving eight finalists and two reserve fighters, with all bouts fought under K-1 rules. Seven of the finalists had won elimination fights at the K-1 World MAX 2005 World Tournament Open, while the eighth, Virgil Kalakoda, had been invited despite losing his elimination match. The two reserve fighters had qualified via preliminary tournaments; Artur Kyshenko had won the K-1 East Europe MAX and Rayen Simson had won the K-1 MAX Netherlands. As well as tournament matches there were also a two opening fights and two super fights fought under K-1 rules (middleweight and heavyweight). In total there were eighteen fighters at the event, representing nine countries. The tournament was won by Buakaw Por. Pramuk who defeated Andy Souwer in the final. Prior to the tournament both fighters had stated their intention to be the first fighter to win two K-1 MAX finals, with Buakaw becoming the first two-time champion defeating Souwer via KO in the second round of their match. Other results saw Muay Thai world champion Yodsanklai Fairtex defeat SuperLeague starlet Kamal El Amrani and Kenpo Karate expert Fernando Calleros defeated local fighter Kozo Takeda, both by decision. The event was held at the Yokohama Arena in Yokohama, Japan on Friday, 30 June 2006, in front of a sellout crowd of 16,918 and was broadcast live across Japan on TBS.

en.s: The Chilean presidential primaries of 2013 were held in Chile on Sunday 30 June 2013. The two main political coalitions decided to participate: Former president Michelle Bachelet won the Nueva Mayoría primary with 73% of the vote, while former senator and minister Pablo Longueira won the Alianza primary with 51%. en.t: 2015 Sumatra Indonesian Air Force C-130 crash

en.s: The 2019 Koreas–United States DMZ Summit was a one-day summit held at the Korean Demilitarized Zone between North Korean chairman Kim Jong Un, U.S. president Donald Trump, and South Korean president Moon Jae-in, following the 2019 G20 Osaka summit. en.t: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress
en.s: The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (NPCSC) is the permanent organ of the National People's Congress (NPC), the supreme organ of state power of the People's Republic of China. It exercises the powers of the NPC when it is not in session, which generally meets once a year. The NPC and its Standing Committee were established in 1954, following the adaptation of the 1954 Constitution of China.
en.n: The Hong Kong National Security Law is passed by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and immediately comes into effect after gazettal.

zh.t: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会通过香港《国安法》
zh.s: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会（全国人大常委会）是中华人民共和国最高国家权力机关全国人民代表大会的常设机关。全国人大通常每年召开一次会议，其闭会期间由全国人大常委会行使职权。全国人民代表大会及其常务委员会于1954年通过《中华人民共和国宪法》后设立。
zh.n: 全国人大常委会通过《香港国安法》，该法在刊宪后立即生效。

en.s: The Tiger Fire was a wildfire that burned 16,278 acres (6,587 ha) in the U.S. state of Arizona from June to July 2021. The fire was caused by a dry lightning strike in the Prescott National Forest. Although Horsethief Basin Lake was evacuated and both the community of Crown King and the census-designated place of Black Canyon City were threatened, no injuries or deaths were reported, and no buildings were damaged or destroyed.

en.s: Fantastica Mania (also stylized as Fantasticamania) is a series of annual professional wrestling shows co-promoted by Mexican professional wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) and Japanese New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW), with Revolution Pro Wrestling (RevPro) also co-promoting Fantastica Mania shows in the UK with CMLL. zh.s: Fantastica Mania（也写作Fantasticamania）是由墨西哥职业摔角推广机构世界摔角理事会（CMLL）与日本新日本职业摔角（NJPW）联合主办的年度赛事系列。英国的RevPro也会与CMLL合办Fantastica Mania赛事。自2011年以来，该系列每年1月至2月在日本举办，每届包括2至7场比赛。

en.s: Following the first round of the 2024 French legislative election on 30 June 2024, runoff elections in each constituency where no candidate received a vote share greater than 50 percent were scheduled for 7 July.
